mapper.insert: INSERT INTO t_journal_line (id, journal_entry_id, line_no, instruction_line_id, account_id, entry_side, amount, create_time) VALUES (#{line.id}, #{line.journalEntryId}, #{line.lineNo}, #{line.instructionLineId}, #{line.accountId}, #{line.entrySide}, #{line.amount}, #{line.createTime})
mapper.select: SELECT l.line_no, l.account_id, c.account_code, a.owner_type, a.owner_id, a.balance_bucket, l.entry_side, l.amount FROM t_journal_line l JOIN t_account a ON a.id = l.account_id JOIN t_chart_account c ON c.id = a.chart_account_id WHERE l.journal_entry_id = #{journalEntryId} ORDER BY l.line_no
